metadata.title: Each simplex in $\mathbb{R}^4$ has a point with at least $14$ emanating normals to its boundary
metadata.abstract: We prove that each simplex in $\mathbb{R}^4$ contains a point with at least $14$ emanating normals to the boundary. Earlier, the authors proved that each generic simple polytope in $\mathbb{R}^4$ contains a point with at least $12$ emanating normals to the boundary. This problem belongs to a piecewise linear counterpart of a longstanding problem concerning normals to smooth convex bodies.

analysis.workSummary: 证明 R⁴ 中任意单纯形内部存在一点，从该点向边界发出的法线至少有 14 条。
analysis.breakthrough: 把此前一般位置简单多胞体的 12 条下界提高到单纯形的 14 条。
analysis.limitations: 结论仅针对四维单纯形，且摘要未给出最优性。 本条数学解读依据官方摘要与评论；论文全文尚未作数学审读，AI 披露另行核查。

analysis.priorityReason: 按几何相关性、结果新颖性、技术可复用性及摘要证据清晰度综合评分 48/100；重点在于把此前一般位置简单多胞体的 12 条下界提高到单纯形的 14 条。
analysis.lowPriorityReason: 与本简报三类几何核心问题的直接关联较弱，或当前摘要证据不足以支持更高阅读优先级。
